items.title: Cloud AI Update - AI Accelerator Market Poised for Significant Growth by 2030
items.summary: The global AI accelerator market is experiencing significant growth, projected to expand from $151 billion in 2025 to $443 billion by 2030, according to a recent report. This surge is fueled by the increased adoption of generative AI, deployment of large language models, and substantial investments in data-center and edge infrastructure.
